substitutions.notes: Starter plan limits: 1 variable mode and 3 pages per file. Light/dark is therefore implemented as two collections (Color, Color Dark) with identical variable names rather than two modes in one collection. Pages are 3 with sections/frames inside. v1 is light-mode and compact-only; Color Dark and expanded breakpoints are deferred.

history.detail: tokens/components/screens/flows generated from code + handoff at 81dc7a7; no Figma writes performed.
Design file sf2EOTYc8LBadE7LpIu8kR and FigJam board 2O145eRxj0Ta11iwIMwuEH created on plan team::1556872439110631612; session 3c99d509-1931-4c41-9308-5a8c0f15db0f.

P1: 3 pages, 36 color variables in Color (Light) + 36 in Color Dark, 13 float variables (space/radius/size), 13 text styles, 3 effect styles. Plus Jakarta Sans confirmed available (Regular/Medium/SemiBold/Bold/ExtraBold).
P2 pilot: Button set (4 variants x 4 states, node 4:34) and Card set (2x3, node 4:53). Variants laid out in grids after combineAsVariants. Visual QA passed on a 460x264 render.

Brand system v1: BRAND.md, Ledger E mark, app icon + adaptive foreground, 9 ledger-line illustrations. Imported into Figma and composed as Brand — Board v1 (node 8:82). 9 illustrations under 160x160, exported from SVG sources in docs/brand/source/.

Built Input (16) 12:94 and AppBar (8) 12:135 plus 18 icon components. Font-codepoint glyphs were wrong (Figma Material Icons release differs from Flutter's). Uploaded 18 official Material Symbols SVGs as loose frames. The fix call (docs/figma/build/p2-icons-fix.js) was blocked by the Starter MCP quota before executing. See RESUME.md.

Confirmed the Starter quota still blocks use_figma (whoami: Starter/View). Evaluated the REST API and rejected it for building: read-only apart from comments, variables and dev resources. Adopted a local development plugin at docs/figma/plugin/ (flat code.js, no UI, no bundler) which runs the same Plugin API code unmetered; figma-linux supports development-plugin import. User installs it once; P2a fix is the first batch.
